name: CAPS short-term counseling
cost: Up to 4 individual sessions a year, plus 4 more with UC SHIP. Prepaid with UC SHIP. Without UC SHIP: $30 per session.
where: John Wooden Center West, 221 Westwood Plaza, or telehealth
hours: Same-day phone triage: Mon–Thu 9 am–4 pm, Fri 9 am–3 pm
how_to_start: Call 310-825-0768 for a same-day phone triage. The call comes from a blocked number.

name: CAPS Wellness Skills Group
cost: Prepaid with UC SHIP. Without UC SHIP: $30 per group session.
hours: 3-session series, about 1 hour each. Dates are posted each quarter.
how_to_start: Requires a CAPS triage or a referral from your CAPS provider, then pre-registration. Groups are closed once a series starts.

name: CAPS therapy group
cost: Prepaid with UC SHIP. Without UC SHIP: $30 per group session.
hours: Weekly, 6–8 students. Days and times are set each quarter.
how_to_start: Therapy groups need a referral from a CAPS clinician. If you're not in CAPS care yet, start with a CAPS triage call. Enrollment usually opens in week 1 or 2 of the quarter, and you can ask to be waitlisted.

name: Off-campus therapist through UC SHIP
org: UC SHIP (Anthem network) with a CAPS referral
cost: $0 copay for outpatient therapy with an Anthem provider, once you have a current CAPS referral.
where: Varies by therapist (search CAPS's provider database, WellTrack Connect)
how_to_start: 1) Call CAPS to request a referral, or check that yours is current (referrals last one year). Referral questions: (310) 794-5523. 2) Contact in-network therapists and ask if they have openings. CAPS may also refer you to UCLA Student Behavioral Health Services.

name: CAPS Drop-in Hours
cost: Free.
where: Campus locations listed on CAPS's Drop-in page
hours: Check the CAPS Drop-in page for this quarter's times
how_to_start: Drop in during posted hours. No appointment needed. This is a brief, confidential consultation, not ongoing therapy, and the counselor can point you to next steps.

name: LiveHealth Online therapy (through CAPS)
org: Video therapy via Anthem, arranged by UCLA CAPS
cost: Free. UC SHIP students use their Anthem ID. Students without UC SHIP get coupon codes from CAPS, which cover the visit. Some details on CAPS's page are dated, so confirm when you call.
where: Video or phone with a licensed therapist
hours: 24 hours on weekdays, plus weekends and campus holidays
how_to_start: No CAPS referral needed. Without UC SHIP, call CAPS at 310-825-0768 for coupon codes first. Then sign up at livehealthonline.com.

name: Togetherall
org: Online peer community, free for UCLA students
cost: Free for UCLA students.
how_to_start: Register through the Togetherall link on the CAPS homepage. You stay anonymous to other members.

name: UCLA Psychology Clinic: individual therapy
org: UCLA Department of Psychology training clinic
cost: Sliding scale by income: $30–$150 per session. Bring proof of income to the first appointment. Insurance billing isn't listed, so ask.
hours: Mon–Thu 8 am–7 pm, Fri 8 am–5 pm
how_to_start: Call 310-825-2305 to ask about openings and schedule an intake. Therapists are supervised doctoral students.

name: UCLA Psychology Clinic: group therapy
org: UCLA Department of Psychology training clinic
cost: $5–$10 per group session on a sliding scale. Intake fee may apply, so ask.
hours: Which groups are running isn't published. Ask the clinic.
how_to_start: Call 310-825-2305 and ask which groups are open now.

name: Open Path Collective
cost: $40–$70 per individual session, set by the therapist. Doesn't bill insurance.
where: Online or in person, depending on the therapist
how_to_start: Sign up on openpathcollective.org, then browse and contact therapists.

name: LA County Department of Mental Health Help Line
cost: Free call. County clinic services are typically covered by Medi-Cal. If you don't have Medi-Cal, confirm cost when you call.
where: Phone line, then a county or contracted clinic near you
how_to_start: Call 800-854-7771 and press 1 for service referrals. They screen and refer you to a provider.

name: In-network therapist through your own plan
cost: Depends on your plan's copay and deductible. Confirm your out-of-pocket cost with your plan before booking.
how_to_start: Call the member services number on your insurance card and ask for in-network therapists taking new clients near UCLA or online.

name: Maple Counseling
cost: Sliding scale. Fee amounts aren't published, so ask during intake. Insurance isn't mentioned, so ask.
where: 1945 S. La Cienega Blvd., Los Angeles 90034, or virtual
hours: Virtual: Mon–Thu 9 am–9 pm, Fri 9 am–5 pm, Sat 9 am–2 pm. In clinic: weekdays, some evenings.
how_to_start: Call the Welcome Center at (310) 271-9999 (Mon–Fri, 9 am–5 pm). They'll help you find the right support.

name: Wright Institute Los Angeles
cost: Sliding scale set from your income and expenses during the phone intake. Amounts aren't published. Doesn't take insurance in network, but can give you a superbill.
where: 11845 W. Olympic Blvd., Suite 505W, Los Angeles 90064, or Zoom
hours: Weekly 50-minute sessions at a set time. No limit on how long therapy lasts.
how_to_start: Request a free intro call through the online form, or call (424) 371-5191. A therapist then does a free 15–20 minute phone intake.

name: Pepperdine West LA Community Counseling Center
cost: Affordable, but fees aren't published on the clinic page. Ask when you call.
where: West Los Angeles (confirm the clinic address when you call)
how_to_start: Call 310-568-5752 or email westlaclinic@pepperdine.edu. New clients start with a phone evaluation.

name: Antioch Community Therapy Services (ACTS)
cost: Low-cost teletherapy. Amounts aren't published, so ask when they contact you.
how_to_start: Fill out the "ACTS is Accepting New Clients" form on Antioch's page. They'll contact you.

name: COLORS LGBTQ Youth Counseling Center
cost: Free.
where: Greater Los Angeles. Ask whether sessions are online or in person.
how_to_start: Submit the information form on colorsyouth.org, call 323-953-5130, or email info@colorsyouth.org. For LGBTQ+ people under 25.

name: Los Angeles LGBT Center: Mental Health Services
cost: Care is offered regardless of ability to pay. Insurance details aren't on this page, so ask about cost and coverage.
where: 1625 N. Schrader Blvd., Hollywood. Most visits are telehealth.
how_to_start: Call 323-993-7500 and choose option 3 for a new appointment.

name: Southern California Counseling Center
cost: Sliding scale based on what you can pay. No insurance required. Accepts L.A. Care Medi-Cal, but not Anthem, Blue Shield, Molina or Health Net.
how_to_start: Go to sccc-la.org/intake and choose "I Need Affordable Counseling," or call 323-937-1344.

name: Didi Hirsch Mental Health Services: outpatient care
cost: Depends on the program and your insurance. Many programs are grant-funded, so eligible clients may pay little or nothing. Intake staff explain any cost.
where: Several LA County clinics, or phone and video sessions
how_to_start: No referral needed. Call 888-807-7250 or use the Centralized Intake form on didihirsch.org.

name: Saban Community Clinic: Behavioral Health
cost: Cost and insurance aren't listed on the behavioral health page. Check their Insurance & Fees page or ask when you request an appointment.
where: Beverly (8405 Beverly Blvd.), Melrose, Hollywood and Virgil health centers
how_to_start: Use the Request an Appointment page on sabancommunityclinic.org. A provider is assigned based on availability.

name: DBSA City of Angels peer support group
org: Depression and Bipolar Support Alliance chapter
cost: Free. Donations welcome.
where: Mondays in person in Los Angeles (ask for the address). Thursdays on Zoom.
hours: Mondays (in person) and Thursdays (Zoom). Start times aren't published, so ask.
how_to_start: Email info@DBSACityofAngels.com or call (213) 290-4136 for times and the location. For adults living with a mood disorder, not family members.

name: DBSA online peer support groups
cost: DBSA describes its peer groups as free, but the page doesn't state a price. Confirm when you register.
hours: Many groups through the week. Pick a time when you register.
how_to_start: Use "Join an Online Support Group" on dbsalliance.org/support. Identity and culture groups are also offered.
